points.description: States that the queue is implemented using a circular array (also called a ring buffer or circular queue), i.e. a fixed-size array used cyclically rather than a linear array with shifting. Merely saying 'use an array' without the circular/cyclic idea does not earn this point.
Maintains a front index/pointer that marks the front of the queue toward the beginning of the array.
Maintains a rear index/pointer that marks the rear of the queue toward the end of the array.
Allows the rear pointer/index to wrap around to the start of the array when it reaches the end, e.g. by using modulo arithmetic or resetting it to 0.

rubric.notes: Full marks require the circular-array idea, front and rear indices/pointers, and the rear pointer wrapping to the start. An answer that only says 'use an array' or describes shifting all elements earns no marks for the circular-array point. Award each pointer/wrap point only when that specific detail is stated or clearly implied.
